profile_text.body:
X Corp is a for-profit startup founded in 2023 and headquartered in Bastrop, Texas, operating at x.com. Its site presents X as a destination for breaking news, entertainment, sports and politics, offering what it describes as the full story with live commentary. Visitors sign in with an email address or username, and the sign-in flow references the company's Terms of Service, Privacy Policy and Cookie Use.

The site's navigation links to Grok alongside About, Get App, Help, Terms, Privacy, Cookies, Careers, Ads & Business, Developers, News, US TIDA and Accessibility, and the footer carries a copyright notice for X Corp. No products or MCP servers are listed for the company.

Its recorded law exposure is in Texas, with a count of 125. No lawsuits are listed.
